description:
FILED s543b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-16) while fixing #5005.  PRE-EXISTING (base c5f618f2 = the same).  SILENT WRONG.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 | PCL; a 3-line file):
    my $f = "/tmp/c.txt"; open my $w, ">", $f; print $w "l1\nl2\nl3\n"; close $w;
    open my $h, "<", $f; my $r = do { 1, <$h> }; my $n = () = <$h>;
    print "[", ($r =~ s/\n//r), "] left $n\n";
    # perl: [l1] left 2        PCL: [3] left 0
(`my $t = (1, <$h>)` is right in PCL: an explicit scalar context pushes down to the last element, #611.)

WHERE: Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_progn_form, the INHERIT / VOID branch: `annotate_contexts` gives a comma list's children LIST context unconditionally, and the branch emits `(if *wantarray* (p-flatten-args (list ... (p-list-ctx (p-readline $h)))) (progn ... (p-list-ctx (p-readline $h))))` -- the SAME forms in both arms, so in scalar context the last element still runs in LIST context (a readline reads the whole file and the do-block's value is its count; a backtick, `reverse`, `localtime`, a sub call's wantarray answer are wrong the same way).  The value position of a do-block / sub tail / eval tail whose last statement is a comma expression ending in a context-sensitive operand.

DIRECTION: in the scalar arm, the LAST element lowered in SCALAR context (the #611 push-down's rule), i.e. the last kid generated twice -- or the kids lowered in INHERIT context so each reads *wantarray* (and `(if (eq *wantarray* t) ...)` rather than `(if *wantarray* ...)`, since :void is true).  An emission change for every such site: corpus-diff + emission-ab.  s543b's #5005 sidesteps it for the `local TERM, TAIL` value by lowering the two arms apart (Parser2::_lower_local).


=== DONE (s543j, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22; WIP 6 f023c923) ===
ExprToCL::gen_progn_form: an INHERIT comma list's LAST kid takes INHERIT_CTX (the #611 push-down's rule), so its form reads *wantarray* and the two arms of the existing `(if *wantarray* LIST SCALAR)` read it in list / scalar context -- one generation, no leading element evaluated twice.  Chosen over the `(eq *wantarray* t)` direction: with the last kid inheriting, :void taking the list arm reads it in VOID context, so the eq test would only change an allocation while moving every comma-tail site.  Probes the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee) scratch/s543j/probes/m6 (15): base 7, tree 15 = perl (do / sub / eval tails, if-arm, ternary, reverse, localtime, backtick, grep, wantarray, arrays / hashes last, `return (1, <$h>)`, an assignment last, void).  Guard Pl/t/list-scalar-context-01.t #5125 row (inverse ok).
